facts.fact: According to a Deloitte survey cited by StackAdapt, the number of smart devices in the average US home has more than doubled since 2019.
facts.quote: the number of smart devices in the average US home has more than doubled since 2019

facts.fact: According to data from Deloitte cited by StackAdapt, the average US household in 2022 has a total of 22 connected devices.
facts.quote: the average US household in 2022 has a total of 22 connected devices

facts.fact: StackAdapt states that since 2013, daily screen time has increased by nearly 50 minutes per day.
facts.quote: Since 2013, daily screen time has increased by nearly 50 minutes per day.

facts.fact: StackAdapt states that the average American spends 7 hours and 4 minutes looking at a screen every day.
facts.quote: Now, the average American spends 7 hours and 4 minutes looking at a screen every day.

facts.fact: StackAdapt defines cross-device ad targeting as the practice of serving digital ads to the same consumer across multiple devices.
facts.quote: Cross-device ad targeting is the practice of serving digital ads to the same consumer across multiple devices.

facts.fact: StackAdapt describes deterministic cross-device tracking as relying on consumer logins as an identifier to match devices to one user, which it says tends to be pretty accurate but can be somewhat limited in reach.
facts.quote: Deterministic cross-device tracking relies on consumer logins as an identifier to match consumers’ devices to one user.

facts.fact: StackAdapt describes probabilistic cross-device targeting as using models and algorithms with non-personal data points such as IP address, time of day, device type, cookies, and other identifiers to infer whether two devices are used by the same individual.
